capabilities: Crawl a URL and score it against 94 rules in 15 categories (SEO, content, links, images, security, crawlability)
Save each audit run as three exports in a per-site folder
Display the report in a full-width dashboard tab with scores, issues, fixes and per-page findings
Keep audit history grouped by site in the sidebar
Enrich audits with Core Web Vitals via a Google PageSpeed Insights API key
extras: Documents a known trade-off: because redirects are auto-followed, the redirect-chain rule always reports 0. Notes saved by versions up to 0.5.x embedded the full report as JSON inside the note; those still open in the dashboard.
problem: Running a website audit normally means an external tool, and Obsidian has no way to store those reports as searchable notes alongside the rest of a vault.

relations.evidence: It wraps the Safi-Studio-Scanner engine, which crawls a site and scores it
To add Core Web Vitals and accessibility checks, paste a Google PageSpeed Insights API key

summary: Website auditor that crawls a URL and saves an SEO, content, link, image and security report as Markdown notes in the vault.
